incompleteCases.question: 各客服分类中尚未解决的工单有多少张？所有分类都输出，缺失计0；仅输出分类ID、分类名和数量，按分类ID升序。
按工单分类名称汇总客服消息记录数，只看确实有消息的分类；输出分类名和消息数，按数量降序、分类名升序。
有多少个正常会员至少有一张属于已结束营销活动的优惠券使用记录？只输出不同会员人数，不限制订单状态。
按会员当前等级名称统计拥有1星评价有效订单的不同会员人数；订单排除取消及不可用，只输出等级名称和人数，人数降序、等级名升序。

itemEvidence.finalSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members WHERE status = 2 AND points >= 500;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE product_weight_g BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_carrier_date IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card' AND payment_installments > 6;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_title IS NULL OR review_comment_title = '';
SELECT member_id, points FROM members WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY points DESC NULLS LAST, member_id ASC LIMIT 7;
SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name FROM campaigns WHERE budget > 10000 AND status = 3 ORDER BY campaign_id LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS coupon_count FROM coupons WHERE discount_type = 'fixed' AND min_order_amount >= 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inventory_count FROM inventory WHERE quantity < safety_stock;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refunds WHERE reason_code = 'QUAL' AND status = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 4 AND resolved_at IS NULL;
SELECT settlement_id, net_amount FROM settlements WHERE status = 3 ORDER BY net_amount DESC NULLS LAST, settlement_id LIMIT 8;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS referral_count FROM referrals WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL AND reward_amount > 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_logs WHERE result_count = 0 AND clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_change_count FROM product_price_history WHERE new_price < old_price;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM shipping_addresses WHERE is_default = true AND state = 'SP';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments WHERE status = 3 AND delivered_at IS NULL;
SELECT DISTINCT seller_city FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP' AND seller_city IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seller_city LIMIT 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count FROM member_snapshot WHERE points IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items WHERE freight_value > price;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS member_count, ROUND(AVG(points), 2) AS avg_points FROM members GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 201
SELECT discount_type, COUNT(*) AS coupon_count, MAX(discount_value) AS max_discount FROM coupons GROUP BY discount_type ORDER BY discount_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY total_refund DESC NULLS LAST, reason_code ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id HAVING SUM(quantity) >= 500 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, warehouse_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_city) AS city_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY city_count DESC, seller_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

SELECT product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND product_weight_g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY avg_weight DESC, product_category_name LIMIT 6;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM shipments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaign_count, SUM(budget) AS total_budget FROM campaigns GROUP BY campaign_type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY campaign_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT referrer_member_id, COUNT(*) AS conversion_count, SUM(reward_amount) AS total_reward FROM referrals WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY referrer_member_id ORDER BY total_reward DESC NULLS LAST, referrer_member_id LIMIT 5;
SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS movement_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inventory_movements GROUP BY movement_type ORDER BY movement_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_logs WHERE result_count > 0 AND keyword IS NOT NULL GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC, keyword LIMIT 9;

SELECT sender_type, COUNT(*) AS message_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE content IS NOT NULL AND content <> '') AS nonempty_count FROM ticket_messages GROUP BY sender_type ORDER BY sender_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT status, SUM(commission) AS total_commission, SUM(net_amount) AS total_net FROM settlements GROUP BY status ORDER BY status NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS mapping_count FROM product_brand_map GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY mapping_count DESC, product_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS brand_count FROM brands GROUP BY country ORDER BY brand_count DESC, country ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
SELECT refund_qty, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(refund_value) AS total_refund FROM refund_items GROUP BY refund_qty ORDER BY refund_qty NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT order_status, MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status LIMIT 201
SELECT seller_id, SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_freight DESC, seller_id LIMIT 4;

SELECT TO_CHAR(order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (6,7);

SELECT order_purchase_timestamp::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 31;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT resolved_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at >= '2018-01-01' AND resolved_at < '2018-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(requested_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 AND requested_at >= '2018-01-01' AND requested_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM searched_at)::int AS hour, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_logs WHERE searched_at >= '2018-03-01' AND searched_at < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT TO_CHAR(register_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members WHERE register_date >= '2017-10-01' AND register_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments WHERE shipped_at >= '2018-02-01' AND shipped_at < '2018-03-01' AND delivered_at >= shipped_at + INTERVAL '7 days';
SELECT TO_CHAR(used_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM coupon_usages WHERE used_at >= '2018-01-01' AND used_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0), 2) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at >= '2018-01-01' AND resolved_at < '2018-02-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year, MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (converted_at - created_at)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days FROM referrals WHERE converted_at >= '2018-04-01' AND converted_at < '2018-05-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT changed_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS decrease_count FROM product_price_history WHERE new_price < old_price AND changed_at >= '2018-03-01' AND changed_at < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 31;
SELECT TO_CHAR(paid_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(net_amount) AS total_net FROM settlements WHERE status = 3 AND paid_at >= '2018-01-01' AND paid_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_name, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members m JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id WHERE m.status = 2 GROUP BY l.level_name ORDER BY member_count DESC, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM ticket_categories c LEFT JOIN support_tickets t ON t.category_id = c.category_id AND t.resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_id LIMIT 201

SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS shipment_count FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND s.status = 4 GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY w.warehouse_id LIMIT 201

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, COUNT(u.usage_id) AS usage_count FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN coupons p ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id LEFT JOIN coupon_usages u ON u.coupon_id = p.coupon_id GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name ORDER BY c.campaign_id LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_tag_map t WHERE t.member_id = m.member_id);

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM user_tags t JOIN user_tag_map x ON x.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = x.member_id WHERE m.status = 2 GROUP BY t.tag_name ORDER BY member_count DESC,t.tag_name LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC,c.customer_state LIMIT 10;
SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 4 AND c.customer_state = 'SP';
SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(i.price) AS total_price FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_price DESC,s.seller_state LIMIT 8;

SELECT b.brand_id,b.brand_name,COUNT(DISTINCT m.product_id) AS product_count FROM brands b JOIN product_brand_map m ON m.brand_id=b.brand_id WHERE m.is_current=true GROUP BY b.brand_id,b.brand_name ORDER BY product_count DESC,b.brand_id LIMIT 10;

SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, COUNT(*) AS shortage_count FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY w.warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT c.campaign_id,c.campaign_name FROM campaigns c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_products p WHERE p.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) ORDER BY c.campaign_id LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM ticket_categories c JOIN support_tickets t ON t.category_id = c.category_id JOIN ticket_messages m ON m.ticket_id = t.ticket_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY message_count DESC, c.category_name LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_name, COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM search_logs s JOIN members m ON m.member_id = s.member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id WHERE m.status = 1 GROUP BY l.level_name ORDER BY search_count DESC, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, r.macro_region LIMIT 201

SELECT i.product_id,SUM(x.refund_qty) AS total_qty FROM refunds r JOIN refund_items x ON x.refund_id=r.refund_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=x.order_id AND i.order_item_id=x.order_item_id WHERE r.status=4 AND r.requested_at>='2018-01-01' AND r.requested_at<'2018-07-01' GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC,i.product_id LIMIT 6;

SELECT s.seller_state,SUM(t.net_amount) AS total_net FROM settlements t JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id=t.seller_id WHERE t.status=3 GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_net DESC,s.seller_state LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY product_count DESC,t.product_category_name_english LIMIT 7;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members m WHERE m.status=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon_usages u WHERE u.member_id=m.member_id);

SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status LIMIT 201

SELECT i.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) AS category_count FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.warehouse_id ORDER BY i.warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT m.member_id,m.points,COUNT(*) AS search_count FROM members m JOIN search_logs s ON s.member_id=m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id,m.points ORDER BY search_count DESC,m.member_id LIMIT 6;

SELECT l.level_name, SUM(i.price) AS total_price FROM member_levels l JOIN members m ON m.level_id = l.level_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY l.level_name ORDER BY total_price DESC, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT b.brand_id,b.brand_name,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,SUM(i.price) AS total_price FROM brands b JOIN product_brand_map x ON x.brand_id=b.brand_id AND x.is_current=true JOIN products p ON p.product_id=x.product_id JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2019-01-01' GROUP BY b.brand_id,b.brand_name ORDER BY total_price DESC,b.brand_id LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, l.level_name, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM campaigns a JOIN coupons p ON p.campaign_id = a.campaign_id JOIN coupon_usages u ON u.coupon_id = p.coupon_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = u.member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id WHERE m.status = 1 GROUP BY a.campaign_id, a.campaign_name, l.level_name ORDER BY a.campaign_id, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region,k.category_name,COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets t JOIN ticket_categories k ON k.category_id=t.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code=c.customer_state GROUP BY r.macro_region,k.category_name ORDER BY ticket_count DESC,r.macro_region,k.category_name LIMIT 12;

SELECT b.brand_id,b.brand_name,SUM(x.refund_value) AS total_refund FROM refunds r JOIN refund_items x ON x.refund_id=r.refund_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=x.order_id AND i.order_item_id=x.order_item_id JOIN product_brand_map m ON m.product_id=i.product_id AND m.is_current=true JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id=m.brand_id WHERE r.status=4 GROUP BY b.brand_id,b.brand_name ORDER BY total_refund DESC,b.brand_id LIMIT 5;

SELECT b.brand_id,b.brand_name,w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id JOIN product_brand_map m ON m.product_id=i.product_id AND m.is_current=true JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id=m.brand_id GROUP BY b.brand_id,b.brand_name,w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC,b.brand_id,w.warehouse_id LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members m WHERE m.status=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon_usages u JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_id=u.coupon_id JOIN campaigns a ON a.campaign_id=c.campaign_id WHERE u.member_id=m.member_id AND a.status=3);

SELECT l.level_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM member_levels l JOIN members m ON m.level_id = l.level_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY l.level_name ORDER BY member_count DESC, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(i.price) AS total_price FROM regions r JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_state = r.region_code JOIN order_items i ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY total_price DESC, r.macro_region LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_name, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id WHERE r.status = 4 AND r.requested_at >= '2018-01-01' AND r.requested_at < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY l.level_name ORDER BY total_refund DESC, l.level_name LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.status = 4)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201

WITH buyers AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct FROM buyers LIMIT 201

WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.amount, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov FROM orders o LEFT JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result_count = 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS zero_result_pct FROM search_logs WHERE searched_at >= '2018-03-01' AND searched_at < '2018-04-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS on_time_pct FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT warehouse_id, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity < safety_stock) / COUNT(*), 2) AS shortage_pct FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 4), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(refund_amount), 0), 2) AS refunded_amount_pct FROM refunds WHERE requested_at >= '2018-01-01' AND requested_at < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon_usages u WHERE u.order_id = o.order_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS coupon_order_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM referrals r WHERE r.referrer_member_id = m.member_id AND r.converted_at IS NOT NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS referrer_pct FROM members m WHERE m.status = 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.resolved_at - t.created_at)) / 3600.0 <= c.sla_hours) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS sla_pct FROM support_tickets t JOIN ticket_categories c ON c.category_id = t.category_id WHERE t.created_at >= '2018-01-01' AND t.created_at < '2018-07-01' AND t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND c.sla_hours IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

WITH totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'), 0) AS q1, COALESCE(SUM(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'), 0) AS q2 FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (q2 - q1) / NULLIF(q1, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM totals LIMIT 201

WITH p AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS amount FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id), i AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.amount, 0) - COALESCE(i.amount, 0)), 2) AS amount_difference FROM orders o LEFT JOIN p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 201
